obligations.expected_behavior: Whole-plan terminal validation consumes only explicit hash-bound predecessors from the current run.
forbidden_result: Validation uses predecessors that are not explicit, hash-bound, and run-local.
obligations.observable_result: The validation input records contain explicit hash bindings and run-local predecessor references.
obligations.state_after: Terminal validation proceeds from explicit hash-bound run-local predecessors.
obligations.state_before: Whole-plan terminal validation is preparing to resolve predecessor inputs.
obligations.subject: Whole-plan terminal validation predecessor resolution

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminal validation rejects history inference based on glob matching.
forbidden_result: A glob pattern is used to infer predecessor or history inputs.
obligations.observable_result: Glob-derived history or predecessor selection is rejected.
obligations.state_after: Validation continues only with explicitly identified inputs rather than glob-inferred history.
obligations.state_before: A candidate history or predecessor could otherwise be selected by glob inference.
obligations.subject: Glob-based history inference
obligations.trigger: When terminal validation resolves history or predecessor inputs.

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminal validation rejects history inference based on modification times.
forbidden_result: Modification time ordering is used to infer predecessor or latest history inputs.
obligations.observable_result: Mtime-derived history or predecessor selection is rejected.
obligations.state_after: Validation uses explicit hash-bound run-local references instead of mtime inference.
obligations.state_before: A candidate history or predecessor could otherwise be selected by mtime inference.
obligations.subject: Mtime-based history inference
obligations.trigger: When terminal validation resolves history or predecessor inputs.

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminal validation rejects inference from latest-success history.
forbidden_result: The latest successful historical run is used to infer predecessor or validation inputs.
obligations.state_after: Validation does not rely on latest-success history inference.
obligations.state_before: A prior successful run could otherwise be selected as an inferred predecessor.
obligations.subject: Latest-success history inference
obligations.trigger: When terminal validation resolves history or predecessor inputs.

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminal validation recomputes exact coverage for every active Acceptance.
forbidden_result: Any active Acceptance is omitted from exact coverage recomputation.
Approximate or non-exact coverage is treated as exact.
obligations.observable_result: Each active Acceptance has a newly computed exact coverage result before validation completes.
obligations.state_after: Exact coverage results exist for all active Acceptances and are used by terminal validation.
obligations.state_before: Active Acceptances require terminal coverage validation.
obligations.subject: Active Acceptance coverage
obligations.trigger: When whole-plan terminal validation evaluates active Acceptances.

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminal validation re-reads runtime evidence immediately before publication.
forbidden_result: Publication relies on stale or previously read runtime evidence.
obligations.observable_result: Runtime evidence is read again in the pre-publication validation step.
obligations.state_after: Publication is based on freshly re-read runtime evidence.
obligations.state_before: Runtime evidence exists but may have changed since an earlier read.
obligations.subject: Runtime evidence pre-publication reread
obligations.trigger: Before terminal validation publishes its result.

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminal validation re-reads the current snapshot immediately before publication.
forbidden_result: Publication relies on a stale or previously read snapshot.
obligations.observable_result: The current snapshot is read again in the pre-publication validation step.
obligations.state_after: Publication is based on the current re-read snapshot.
obligations.state_before: A snapshot exists but may have changed since an earlier read.
obligations.subject: Current snapshot pre-publication reread
obligations.trigger: Before terminal validation publishes its result.
